checks.name: Actual common graph
checks.finding: D.83/D.87 retain the same A*kappa(5) graph in global and local images, with away-five translation lattice 5^r Z5 and local lattice 5^N Z5. No graph is replaced by an abstract complement.

checks.name: Actual primitive operators
checks.finding: Read D.82 exact image and tame projector proof. Its actual delta in {chi=1,kappa5=0} has beta-1=P times a unit, and actual tau with kappa5=1 exists by saturated local Kummer image.

checks.name: Integral operator ideal
checks.finding: The two actual operator differences generate (P,t1^A-1); A a unit gives precisely (u). Conversely every difference lies there by integral binomial divisibility. The same finite ideal acts on R and on the actual ideal J.

checks.name: Natural zero map
checks.finding: Every N0-invariant functional on R kills uR; actual inclusion J=q_r R is contained in uR. Thus the invariant restriction map is literally zero, not merely zero in a dimension calculation.

checks.name: Exact retained generator
checks.finding: J/uJ is (Z/5^e)[[v]] at finite depth and Z5[[v]] at infinite depth. Actual q_r substitution contributes chi, the Alexander factor at u=0 contributes chi*S_chi(t2), and Cartier untwist removes one chi, leaving chi*S_chi(t2).

checks.name: Weighted shell topology
checks.finding: Multiplication by v gives the augmentation ideal with chi-weighted substitution. The missing tame chi quotient has no invariants or coinvariant correction. Invariant dual functions vanish at0, have inverse-unit weight on each nonzero shell, and only finitely many nonzero shells; this yields the stated compact product, with exact exponent.

checks.name: Whole finite-localization term
checks.finding: D.87 supplies one finite coefficient level for every class and all places, so the calculation identifies S itself rather than a larger unrestricted kernel.

checks.name: No free boundary term
checks.finding: The valuation coefficient A is a unit, hence both global and local depth of a and a-b are0. The b=0 axis gives the identical countable product; D.77 natural map is an isomorphism, so K=S.

checks.finding: The rational tangents have coefficient1 at5, away depth r and logarithmic depth r+e. The endpoint adds kappa(5) to D.88.24. The theorem correctly excludes nonunit nonzero A and asserts no general section criterion.
